reasons: Timestamp validation uses corroborated provider response time (-56 seconds relative to the local capture clock). Event timestamps and local capture times are unchanged. HTTP clocks may share infrastructure; this is not independent UTC certification.
Public explorer holder, creator and funding fallback currently supports Ethereum and Base. Other chains retain available public snapshots and pool trades.

Public trade scope: at most 300 recent trades from one selected pool, normally within 24 hours. Transaction sender may be a relayer or shared service. Sample net buying is not current holdings; no complete launch or first-buyer history is established.

Token-2022 recognized mint extension capabilities are decoded from the finalized RPC snapshot; unsupported or malformed extensions remain explicit. Hook program behavior, historical changes and hidden balances are not audited. Displayed balances are raw base amounts divided by decimals.

Solana snapshot covers at most 20 token accounts selected at one finalized slot, then aggregates their verified balances by parsed owner at a later finalized slot. An owner may have more accounts outside this sample; these are sampled balances and shares, not complete wallet holdings or a distinct-holder census.

RPC snapshot slots are preserved; retrieval timestamps are not block timestamps. Current mint/freeze authority does not identify the historical creator. No launch, first-buyer, funding or historical-balance completeness is established.

Alchemy decoded 200 successful timestamped transactions from bounded oldest/latest mint-address history. 0 invalid/failed records were withheld. Only canonical Pump swaps with verified token-account transfers are classified; other programs and routes remain unclassified.

Mint-address indexing and bounded pages do not prove complete token-wide launch coverage. First-minute sniper labels are withheld. Native funding checks cover the first 20 indexed transactions of up to 6 observed buyers/current holders, one hop. Only incoming transfers strictly before a known first observed buy and outside target-token activity are eligible funding; sale proceeds, refunds, same-second transfers and holders without a known buy remain observations only. An absent result does not establish self-funding.

This archive covers ascending finalized mint-address indexed transactions only, not complete token-wide history or verified launch coverage. Native transfers remain observations, not acquisition funding. Only supported canonical Pump instructions establish trades.
History retrieval paused at the saved checkpoint.
Report subset: transfers includes 3000 of 97095 archived records (oldest half and newest half by event timestamp). Other records remain saved but are outside this report analysis.
Selected-pool verification currently supports Ethereum and Base only.
One or more row or wallet caps were reached. Expand scope where available; results are not exhaustive.

413 native receipt(s) below the 0.0001 SOL per-transfer inference floor remain visible as observations but do not establish funding, creator links or connected selling. This conservative policy is not proof of spam and can omit genuine small funding; split receipts are not summed to bypass the floor. No equivalent EVM or token-amount threshold is applied.
